metadata.description: One marketplace for AI-agent delegation plugins — Codex and Claude Code (cc) via profiles — plus image generation.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

plugins.name: cc
plugins.description: Run tasks on a headless Claude Code instance, selected by profile — usable from Claude Code or a Codex host via handoff

plugins.name: imagine
plugins.description: Generate images from Claude Code with xAI Grok Imagine or Google Antigravity (agy) — prompt-craft guidance and a verified path on disk, whichever engine renders it.
